requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh invokes python3 /app/solution.py --input <bundle> --output <path> and re-invokes it on generated variant bundles, so the CLI must accept those two flags and work on arbitrary --input paths.
test.sh greps result.json for /root/, /home/[a-z], /app/, IPv4 addresses, or http(s):// URLs and fails on any match — the report must contain no absolute paths, IPs, or URLs.
must_include: must not contain any absolute filesystem path, host name, or URL

requirements.verifier_assertion: PYCHK asserts set(d) == {resolved_parameters, unset_parameters, scenarios, requirement_results, summary} — exactly the 5 top-level keys.
PYCHK asserts each scenarios[] entry has set(s) == SCEN_KEYS (14 fields) and error_code within enum, status within enum, transitions well-formed with t_ms int and from/to in STATES.
must_include: scenario_id, status, error_code, malformed_rows, clamped_rows, rejected_rows, armed_steps, failsafe_steps, peak_throttle, energy_wh, mean_power_w, soc_end, depleted, transitions

requirements.verifier_assertion: PYCHK asserts each requirement_results[] entry has set(r) == REQ_KEYS (8 fields), verdict within enum, error_code within enum.
must_include: requirement_id, scenario_id, metric, op, threshold, observed, verdict, error_code

requirements.verifier_assertion: PYCHK asserts scenario error_code and requirement error_code are one of the six literal strings.

requirements.verifier_assertion: PYCHK asserts load.base_power=10.0 W (revision file overrides baseline 12.5 W); v_order variant asserts baseline value wins when its filename sorts LAST (baseline capacity 6.0 A*h re-wins, load.base_power 12.5 re-wins).

file-name order decides which overlay wins

throttle is outside [0.0, 1.0] it is clamped

k * step rounded to the nearest integer

PYCHK asserts REQ-SOC evaluated once per scenario (5 entries) with threshold=0.20 (highest revision wins); REQ-PEAK applies only to s01_nominal and s03_noisy with threshold=0.60 (later entry wins on equal revision); REQ-ENERGY applies_to includes 's99_absent' (matches no scenario, silently ignored) so REQ-ENERGY is only evaluated on s01_nominal.
must_include: keep the entry with the largest revision
on equal revision keep the one that appears LATER
Names that match no scenario are ignored silently

requirements.verifier_assertion: PYCHK asserts REQ-PEAK passes on s01_nominal at the 1e-9 tolerance (peak==0.6 vs threshold 0.6); REQ-PEAK fails on s03_noisy; REQ-FS observed 39 on s02_timeout with verdict fail; REQ-FS unknown on s05_empty with observed null and error_code EmptyScenario.
